                [32m'## Background\n'[39m +
                [32m'\n'[39m +
                [32m'Alchemyst AI is a Context Engine that lets agents organize ingested documents into composable groups via the `group_name` metadata array. This is the foundation of "Context Arithmetic".\n'[39m +
                [32m'\n'[39m +
                [32m'In this task you will build a small Python CLI that ingests several documents tagged with overlapping `group_name` values, then performs a filtered search and prints the matching documents as JSON.                 [32m'\n'[39m +
                [32m'Note: In the Python SDK, both add and search use `group_name` (snake\\_case) consistently — unlike the TypeScript SDK which uses `groupName` for search.\n'[39m +
                [32m'\n'[39m +
                [32m'## Requirements\n'[39m +
                [32m'\n'[39m +
                [32m'* Build a Python CLI at `/home/user/myproject/main.py` that uses the `alchemystai` Python SDK.\n'[39m +
                [32m'* The CLI must accept one repeated/variadic argument `--groups` that takes one or more group names (e.g. `--groups eng v1`).\n'[39m +
                [32m'* On every invocation, the CLI must first ingest **at least 3** documents whose `group_name` arrays overlap such that the intersection semantics can be verified. Use these exact documents (content and group assignments):\n'[39m +
                [32m'  * Document A: belongs to groups `["eng", "v1"]`\n'[39m +
                [32m'  * Document B: belongs to groups `["eng", "v2"]`\n'[39m +
                [32m'  * Document C: belongs to groups `["docs", "v1"]`\n'[39m +

                  {
                    type: [32m'text'[39m,
                    text: [32m'Title: \n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'URL Source: https://getalchemystai.com/docs/advanced/context-arithmetic.md\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'Markdown Content:\n'[39m +
                      [32m'> ## Documentation Index\n'[39m +
                      [32m'> Fetch the complete documentation index at: https://getalchemystai.com/docs/llms.txt\n'[39m +
                      [32m'> Use this file to discover all available pages before exploring further.\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'# Context Arithmetic\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'> Understanding the foundational principles on which Alchemyst works\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'## Introduction\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'**Context arithmetic** is the set of rules by which Alchemyst **selects, combines, filters, and ranks context** at query time.\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'It answers a deceptively simple question:\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'> *Given a large universe of documents, which pieces of information should the model see right now—and why?*\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'Unlike traditional retrieval systems that rely on static queries or hard-coded joins, context arithmetic is **dynamic**. The result set is not fixed; it is *computed* based on scope, intent, constraints, and relevance.\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'Think of it less like a database query, and more like **set algebra over meaning**.\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'***\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'### The Mental Model: Context as Sets\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'Every document you ingest belongs to one or more **sets**.\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'These sets are defined implicitly by:\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'* `groupName`\n'[39m +
                      [32m'* metadata fields\n'[39m +
                      [32m'* semantic similarity\n'[39m +
                      [32m'* recency and relevance signals\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'At query time, Alchemyst performs a series of **set operations** to determine what survives into the final context window.\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'Conceptually:\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'```\n'[39m +
                      [32m'Final Context\n'[39m +
                      [32m'  = (Semantic Matches)\n'[39m +
                      [32m'    ∩ (groupName Scope)\n'[39m +
                      [32m'    ∩ (Metadata Filters)\n'[39m +
                      [32m'    − (Deduplicated / Superseded Content)\n'[39m +
                      [32m'```\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'This is context arithmetic.\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'***\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'### Primitive Operations\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'At a high level, Alchemyst applies four core operations.\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'#### 1. **Intersection (AND)**\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'Used to **narrow scope**.\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'When you specify multiple `groupName` values, *all* of them must match.\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'```javascript theme={null}\n'[39m +
                      [32m'search({\n'[39m +
                      [32m'  groupName: ["engineering", "backend", "auth"]\n'[39m +
                      [32m'})\n'[39m +
                      [32m'```\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'This is equivalent to:\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'```\n'[39m +
                      [32m'engineering ∩ backend ∩ auth\n'[39m +
                      [32m'```\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'Only documents that belong to **all three sets** survive.\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'This is why `groupName` is composable—and why flat or overloaded tags break down quickly.\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'***\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'#### 2. **Union (OR)**\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'Used implicitly when:\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'* searching semantically\n'[39m +
                      [32m'* retrieving top-K results\n'[39m +
                      [32m'* expanding related context\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'For example, a query like:\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'> “How does authentication work?”\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'may retrieve documents from:\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'* design docs\n'[39m +
                      [32m'* code\n'[39m +
                      [32m'* past PRs\n'[39m +
                      [32m'* resolved incidents\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'These are **unioned**, then ranked.\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'```\n'[39m +
                      [32m'(Auth Docs ∪ Auth Code ∪ Auth Tickets ∪ Auth PRs)\n'[39m +
                      [32m'```\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'Union increases recall; intersection increases precision.\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'Good context arithmetic balances both.\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'***\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'#### 3. **Subtraction (EXCLUSION)**\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'Used to **remove noise and conflicts**.\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'Common examples:\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'* Older versions of the same document\n'[39m +
                      [32m'* Superseded policies\n'[39m +
                      [32m'* Duplicate or near-duplicate chunks\n'[39m +
                      [32m'* Out-of-scope access groups\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'For example:\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'```\n'[39m +
                      [32m'All Auth Docs\n'[39m +
                      [32m'− Deprecated Docs\n'[39m +
                      [32m'− Draft Versions\n'[39m +
                      [32m'− Private/Internal Scope\n'[39m +
                      [32m'```\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'This is why deduplication, versioning, and delete-then-add semantics matter—they directly affect arithmetic correctness.\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'***\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'#### 4. **Ranking (WEIGHTING)**\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'Once the candidate set is computed, Alchemyst ranks what remains.\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'Ranking signals typically include:\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'* semantic similarity\n'[39m +
                      [32m'* recency\n'[39m +
                      [32m'* metadata signals (priority, freshness)\n'[39m +
                      [32m'* historical usefulness\n'[39m +
                      [32m'* proximity to the query intent\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'Only the **top-ranked** results are passed to the model.\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'This is where cost, latency, and answer quality converge.\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'***\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'### Why This Matters\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'Understanding context arithmetic explains *why* the patterns in this guide exist.\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'* Why hierarchical `groupName` works\n'[39m +
                      [32m'* Why over-segmentation hurts retrieval\n'[39m +
                      [32m'* Why metadata bloat slows everything down\n'[39m +
                      [32m'* Why bulk ingestion and deduplication are not optional\n'[39m +
                      [32m'* Why document size matters more than raw token count\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'If your context structure aligns with arithmetic rules, retrieval feels “magical.”\n'[39m +
                      [32m'If it doesn’t, no amount of prompt engineering will save you.\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'***\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'### A Simple Example\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'Assume your system contains **50,000 documents**.\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'A user asks:\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'> “How do we handle JWT refresh tokens in API v2?”\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'The effective context computation might look like:\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'```\n'[39m +
                      [32m'(\n'[39m +
                      [32m'  SemanticMatches("JWT refresh token")\n'[39m +
                      [32m')\n'[39m +
                      [32m'∩ groupName(["engineering", "backend", "auth"])\n'[39m +
                      [32m'∩ metadata({ version: "v2" })\n'[39m +
                      [32m'− deprecatedDocs\n'[39m +
                      [32m'− supersededVersions\n'[39m +
                      [32m'→ rank → top 5\n'[39m +
                      [32m'```\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'The model never sees:\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'* frontend docs\n'[39m +
                      [32m'* marketing material\n'[39m +
                      [32m'* outdated auth specs\n'[39m +
                      [32m'* irrelevant code paths\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'Not because you filtered manually—but because the **arithmetic worked**.\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'***\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'### Context Arithmetic vs Prompt Stuffing\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'| Prompt Stuffing | Context Arithmetic |\n'[39m +
                      [32m'| --------------- | ------------------ |\n'[39m +
                      [32m'| Static          | Dynamic            |\n'[39m +
                      [32m'| Manual          | Computed           |\n'[39m +
                      [32m'| Token-heavy     | Precision-first    |\n'[39m +
                      [32m'| Fragile         | Composable         |\n'[39m +
                      [32m'| Hard to scale   | Designed for scale |\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'Prompt stuffing assumes *more tokens = better answers*.\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'Context arithmetic assumes:\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'> *Only the right tokens matter.*\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'***\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'### Design Principle\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'> **Structure your context so that correct answers fall out naturally from arithmetic—not from clever prompts.**\n'[39m +
                      [32m'\n'[39m +
                      [32m'If you internalize this section, every pattern below will feel less like a rulebook and more like common sense.\n'[39m +
                      [32m''[39m

                  [32m'    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Context Arithmetic (Intersection) with Alchemyst AI Python SDK")\n'[39m +
